title: Cutting features without cutting the point

videos.script: Every project has to lose features to be finished. The question is which ones, and how, so that what is left still proves the thing it was built to prove. {{which}} The features to cut first are the ones that touch everything. A login touches every screen, every route and every test. Cut it, and a whole layer of work goes with it. {{login}} But cutting does not have to mean nothing. Most features can be replaced by something much smaller that does the same job for now. A typed name instead of an account. One command instead of an admin screen. One query instead of a report. {{standin}} You will see loanbook's stand-ins running. And the two things that are never cut.
